entry.name: gen_dsp_counter
entry.description: Accumulates and outputs a stored count, similarly to Max's counter object, but triggered at sample-rate. The amount to accumulate per sample is set by the first input (incr). The count can be reset by a non-zero value in the second input (reset). The third inlet (max) sets a maximum value; the counter will wrap if it reaches this value. However if the maximum value is set to 0 (the default), the counter will assume no limit and count indefinitely. The first outlet outputs the current count, the second outlet outputs 1 when the count wraps at the maximum and zero otherwise, and the third outlet outputs the number of wraps (the carry count).
